summary: Chitchatter is a peer-to-peer messaging application designed to operate without a central server. Built using Node.js under the GPL-2.0 licence, it provides ephemeral communication channels where data typically bypasses intermediary storage.
goodFor: It suits technical users who require a decentralised, ephemeral communication channel without the dependency on traditional hosted chat infrastructure.
watchOut: The absence of tagged releases and a moderate maintenance velocity indicate that you should expect potential stability issues or manual upgrade efforts when running this in production.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and manage persistent processes or clustering manually.
